issues.display_title: Issue #2856: [Detail Draft] Integrate API Hotspot Mention Avatar
issues.main_description_html:
Integrate the hotspot mention avatar on Detail Draft. BE task: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go#453

No new endpoint — this is a response-shape change on the existing Detail Draft Post endpoint.

What changed (FE-facing)

For hotspots where type = "mention", the hotspot's data object now also contains:

  • avatar — the mentioned user's avatar URL (may be null if not found)

Existing data fields are unchanged; avatar is appended only for type: "mention".

Username format (FE must parse)

data.username is a tag string:

@[royalecheese](vc473434aaf)
  • display name = the @[...] part (royalecheese)
  • the (...) part is the user's encrypt id (used by BE for lookup)
  • plaintext usernames (no @[](...)) are also possible — handle both

Scope

  • extend the typed hotspot DTO: data.avatar?: string for mention hotspots
  • parse @[username](encrypt) → display username (and keep encrypt for navigation if needed)
  • render the avatar on mention hotspots in the draft preview (see #2815)
  • fallback avatar when avatar is null/missing (no broken image)

Testing Scenario (for tester)

  1. Open a draft with a mention hotspot → the mentioned user's avatar renders.
  2. Username displays cleanly (no raw @[...](...) string shown).
  3. Mentioned user without an avatar → fallback renders, no broken image.
  4. Non-mention hotspots are unaffected.

issues.display_title: Issue #2855: [Profile] Integrate API Profile Published Folder Bookmarks
issues.main_description_html:
Integrate the Profile Published Folder Bookmarks API — powers the published bookmark-folder list on the profile Bookmark tab.

BE task: GoThruMedia/panorra-api-go#467

Endpoint

GET /bookmark/published/profile/:username?page=1&limit=9

Path / Query params

  • username (string, required) — profile username
  • page (int, optional) — default 1
  • limit (int, optional) — default 9

Headers

  • Authorization (required) — Bearer <token>
  • role (required) — viewer | user | my-user
  • ec (optional) — true for encrypted response

Role rules (FE must send the right role)

  • viewer → public published folders of a profile
  • user → another user's public published folders (blocked/deactive filtered)
  • my-user → only the authenticated user's own profile (other username → 403)
  • any other role → 401

Response (200)

{ "statusCode": 200, "data": {
  "valid": true, "messages": "List Published Folder Bookmark Profile",
  "folders": [
    { "slug": "ob97a4a99d3-2026040810361400", "name": "CN Tower",
      "thumbnail": "thumbnail.jpg", "published_at": "2026-07-16T00:00:00Z",
      "total_bookmark": 12 }
  ],
  "total": 24, "page": 1, "limit": 9 } }

Folder fields: slug · name · thumbnail · published_at · total_bookmark (no created_at).
Pagination meta: total · page · limit. Sorted by published_at DESC.

Error cases to handle

  • 409 User Not Found
  • 403 Forbidden — my-user on another profile, or blocked target
  • 401 Unauthorized — unsupported role / bad token
  • Empty profile → folders: [], total: 0 → show empty state

Scope

  • typed DTO + src/api method
  • send correct role (viewer / user / my-user) per context (own vs other profile)
  • page/limit pagination (default 9) wired into the profile store
  • loading / empty / error states (401 / 403 / 409 handled distinctly)

Testing Scenario (for tester)

  1. Own profile (my-user) → published folders load with name, thumbnail, total_bookmark.
  2. Another user's profile (user / viewer) → their public published folders load.
  3. my-user with another username → 403 handled gracefully.
  4. Unknown username → 409 handled; profile with none → empty state.
  5. Scroll/paginate → page 2 loads (limit 9); light + dark mode readable.

issues.display_title: Issue #2794: Hotspot auto-focus: center camera on tap + on entering dewarp mode
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Add auto-focus to the panorama viewer so the camera rotates to center a hotspot at the right moments, keeping the "Hotspot in this image" list and the image in sync. Today, with several hotspots, creators must drag the image around to find which point matches which list row. No change to how hotspots are stored — this only changes where the camera looks.

Design spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-14-hotspot-auto-focus-design.md (branch product-docs).

What "focus" means

  • Rotate/center only — no zoom, no filter change.
  • Smooth glide (~0.3–0.5s) to center the hotspot, then the hotspot briefly highlights (pulse/glow).
  • Interruptible: a creator's drag beats an in-progress glide.
  • One shared "focus a hotspot" behavior powers both triggers, so motion/timing/highlight are identical.

Trigger 1 — Tap a hotspot in the "Hotspot in this image" list

  • Tapping a row glide-centers that hotspot and highlights it.
  • Focuses in the current viewer mode — tapping does not switch modes.
  • The tapped row shows as selected and becomes the last-selected hotspot.

Trigger 2 — Switch the viewer to dewarp mode

  • On entering dewarp mode, auto-focus a hotspot so the creator lands on a real hotspot, not an arbitrary direction.
  • Target: last-selected hotspot; if none tapped yet, the first hotspot in the list.
  • Same glide + highlight. If the image has no hotspots, do nothing.

Edge cases

  • Last-selected hotspot deleted → fall back to the first in the list.
  • Tapping the already-focused row → re-center and re-highlight (harmless).
  • Rapid taps → camera follows the most recent tap.
  • No hotspots → no motion, no error.

Out of scope

  • No change to how hotspots are created, stored, or counted.
  • No zoom or filter change.
  • No auto-switching of viewer modes.
  • No pop-ups — focusing is silent and automatic.

Acceptance criteria

  • Tapping a hotspot row glide-centers and briefly highlights that hotspot in the current viewer mode, and marks the row selected.
  • Entering dewarp mode auto-focuses the last-selected hotspot, or the first if none was tapped, or does nothing if there are no hotspots.
  • Focus is center-only (no zoom / no filter change) and the glide is interruptible by touch.
  • The selected list row always matches the currently focused hotspot.
  • Works with light and dark themes.

Source: brainstorming/design spec docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-14-hotspot-auto-focus-design.md
